subject: Request: co-marketing permission in exchange for revenue credit
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@finrex.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: Jeff Calder <jeff.calder@finrex.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Co-marketing/brand use ask tied to discount

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — we're excited about Redwood for our in-app insights use case. One quick ask from our side: to include Redwood as a "Featured Partner" on FinRex's partner page and to use Redwood's logo in an upcoming case study we plan to publish in November.

In the spirit of mutual value, our procurement lead asked if Redwood could provide a revenue credit of $50k against our first-year committed spend in exchange for the publicity and a short joint case study (FinRex will handle quote sourcing and a 1-page highlight). We have standard logo usage guidelines (attached).

Please let me know if this is something your team can accept and what approvals are needed.

Best,
Maya Singh
Head of Marketing, FinRex
maya.singh@finrex.com
[Attachment: logo_guidelines.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@finrex.com>
Cc: Jeff Calder <jeff.calder@finrex.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Co-marketing/brand use ask tied to discount

Thanks, Maya — really appreciate the clarity and the draft guidelines.

We like the idea of a short joint case highlight and partner page placement. I need to run the revenue credit request through our deal desk because $50k is outside my standard approval band.

I copied Karthik (legal/deal desk) and Marissa (Head of Revenue Ops) to evaluate the ask and proposed offsets. Can you confirm the items you expect Redwood to provide for the co-marketing piece (e.g., logo placement duration, joint quote, social posts)? That will help Karthik scope the MoU.

PR: 2 social posts + partner page placement for 12 months, a 1-page customer highlight.

I'll follow up once I have internal confirmation.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Co-marketing/brand use ask tied to discount — approval request

Marissa / Karthik,

Looping you in on a request from FinRex. They are asking for a $50k revenue credit in year one in exchange for a partner page placement, two social posts, and a 1-page case highlight (FinRex will draft the case text and provide quotes). Attached are their logo guidelines.

Quick context: deal ARR is $450k ARR (three-year commitment). My standard concession band covers up to $15k credit — beyond that requires approval. Recommended approach: approve up to $40k credit if we secure a verbal comms timeline and right-to-review on quotes; anything above $40k should go to executive sign-off.

Questions for you: 1) are there any legal brand constraints we should insist on in the MoU? 2) can we formalize a 12-month placement and joint brief as the exchange?

I've summarized proposed terms below for fast review: 
- Concession: up to $50k revenue credit (propose $40k standard approval, $10k exec discretionary)
- Deliverables: partner page placement (12 months), 2 social posts, 1-page customer highlight with Redwood review rights
- Conditions: Redwood right-to-review quotes and logo usage consistent with our guidelines; Redwood may decline any marketing text implying endorsement beyond the agreed quote.

Attaching suggested MoU template (see link) — requesting legal language check and Marissa's sign-off on concession threshold.

Thanks,
Priyom

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-marketing/brand use ask tied to discount — approval request

Thanks Priyom — reviewed the ask and FinRex's logo guidelines. From a deal-desk/legal perspective I recommend: 
1) Approve up to $40k revenue credit at the deal desk level, conditioned on a signed MoU that includes: clear usage period (12 months), single-page case highlight, two social posts, and explicit language giving Redwood approval rights over final copy and logo lockups.
2) Any credit above $40k requires VP/revenue approval and must be tied to measurable marketing milestones (e.g., publication date for the case study and two confirmed social posts within 90 days of launch).
3) Prohibit use of Redwood logo in paid advertising or partnership claims implying endorsement for regulated products.

I've drafted MoU language and attached it to this thread (co_marketing_mou_draft.docx). If Marissa approves the $40k band, I can redline the MoU and route for signature. If you want to push to $50k, Marissa should weigh in and confirm which exec is comfortable with the incremental $10k.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk & Legal Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
[Attachment: co_marketing_mou_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@finrex.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Co-marketing/brand use ask tied to discount — approval request

Priyom / Karthik — thanks for the summary and the draft MoU. I approve authorizing a $40k revenue credit on RDW-2027-4987, subject to the following firm conditions: 
1) Signed MoU in place before credit is applied. Karthik, please incorporate the 12-month placement, two social posts, and explicit Redwood review rights in the document.
2) Milestone gating for the $40k: 50% of the credit applied upon MoU signature, remaining 50% applied after the case highlight is published and at least one social post has gone live.
3) Any request to reach the full $50k must be escalated to me with a proposed measurable incremental comms plan (e.g., additional webinar, paid co-branded campaign) and explicit ROI rationale.
4) Marketing must own final approval of any quote used; legal guardrails around endorsement language remain as proposed.

Priyom: please send the redlined MoU to Maya and finalize signature cadence. Karthik: add the milestone language to the MoU and prepare countersignature steps. Vanessa — FYI on co-marketing placement; loop in comms if needed.

Approving as requested (authorized signatory for the $40k band).

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
